description.en: Clears the flag set by CMND_MESWIN_LOCK (bit 1 of the event system's state flags) and sets another one (bit 2). The events call it after the last message of a run started with CMND_MESWIN_LOCK. The engine code that reads the flags was not traced.

examples.case: After the last message of a conversation (real usage, from ev44010070.nut)
